'''Ixxis and Su's floating game''' was the name given to a semi-regularly series of [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] games run by the scoundrels [[Brali Ixxis]] and [[Prahman Su]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. The games took place in [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] and moved location around the [[City/Legends|city]] throughout each game. Taking place whenever both Ixxis and Su were in Coronet at the same time, players required a personal invite from one of the pair to attend. The game attracted up and coming or experienced [[Gambling/Legends|gamblers]] and card sharks and required a 5000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] initial stake. Those who failed to put up the initial credits where beaten, robbed and thrown out.<ref name="SoF" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ixxis and Su's floating game was first mentioned in ''[[Suns of Fortune]]'', a sourcebook released in [[2014]] for [[Fantasy Flight Games]] ''[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire]]'' roleplaying system.
